items.title: STAT+: GLP-1s are given an FDA warning for rare eye condition risk
items.snippet: The FDA warned that GLP-1 drugs carry a potential risk of a rare but serious eye condition sometimes referred to as an “eye stroke.”
items.line: FDA warning on GLP-1 drugs carrying rare eye condition risk requires patient awareness and raises questions about long-term safety surveillance of widely-used weight-loss medications.

items.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
items.snippet: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.
items.line: Anthropic sets IPO range of $70-78/share targeting $1.4 trillion valuation, making it potentially one of history's largest tech IPOs and signaling explosive AI investor confidence.

items.title: Google Cloud rolls out Gemini for healthcare
items.snippet: The platform was developed alongside clinical and health plan leaders and is built to support HIPAA compliance, the tech giant says.
items.line: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare with HIPAA compliance, signaling major tech companies' commitment to regulated clinical AI deployment.

items.title: Mayo Clinic Platform launches AI-driven clinical decision support tool
items.snippet: Beginning in November, eligible clinicians will have access to two key capabilities: a specialty-specific chat that covers more than 35 specialties and 22 clinical calculators available via chat or voice dictation.
items.line: Mayo Clinic launches AI-driven clinical decision support covering 35+ specialties, demonstrating practical AI integration into real-world hospital workflows.

items.line: Adobe launches agentic AI tools across Photoshop, Premiere and Firefly with MCP support coming 2027, accelerating AI-native creative workflows.
